fixturePreparation: Reused the author's request types, required Field, Knowledge Items, and deflection links by identifier; created five fresh fictional Requests R-46 to R-50 as Jonas Weber through the API with one original PDF each, then posted Legal only, Working team, and Full thread replies (the last with paper) through the Inbox comment panel as Nadia Haddad before any disposition.

Applied the dispositions through the API as the Legal Team Member: R-47 converted to Contract C-37, R-48 to Matter M-24, R-49 resolved with a reply, R-50 declined with a reason. DOC-013 owns those staff controls; this is not acceptance of that guide.

After each disposition Nadia posted a later Full thread reply with paper and a later Legal only note through the staff UI on the Inbox page or the resulting record. Later Document Versions were uploaded to the promoted paper on C-37 and M-24 through the API.
Five failed setup attempts left fictional Requests R-41 to R-45 on Jonas's list without Legal replies; they were not used.

The Knowledge fixture's eligibility, current filenames, and body were read first and restored at the end; the primary Document carries the extra Versions this run uploaded, with the original filename and bytes current again.
corrections: submit-request, If it does not work: the sentence "If a number is refused, enter it as a number." was removed. The form's number question is a native number control, which holds an empty value for letters, so the form reports a missing answer and the "enter this as a number" refusal cannot be produced by typing in Chromium. The fixture type has no number question; the control behaviour was checked directly. The submission and discovery walkthroughs were rerun in full against the corrected bytes; the tested hashes list both revisions.
observations: A failed step in the first follow-up run was a reviewer harness fault: after 55 extra Full thread markers the newest page no longer carried the "later reply" text the check looked for. The step record is retained; the two recovery checks were rerun with the newest marker as the target and passed on unchanged guide bytes.
Deflection links carry the Administrator's label ("Docs available guidance …"), not the Knowledge Item's title; the guide already tells the reader to check the title under From Legal after opening.

The fixture's unavailable external address is served by the lab app as a not-found route (HTTP 200 with the app shell), not a network failure; the new-tab, retained-answers, and successful-submission checks hold either way.

Help with this page on a Portal Request lists only the follow-up guide (topic portal.request); the Portal header Help on the same routes combines topics and also lists the comments and notifications guides.

The Knowledge page has no Help with this page entry; its header Help resolves topic portal.knowledge on the preview reader and plain /portal/help on the committed lab, where the article is excluded as intended.

limitations: Independent agent walkthrough by a different agent from the author; not a human user study and not the feature owner's approval.
Dispositions were applied through the API as the Legal Team Member; the Inbox conversion, resolution, and decline controls belong to DOC-013.
No upload size limit was exercised; the guide's file-size sentence stays conditional and unverified in this lab.

The Knowledge Documents check keys on filename; the first run compared bytes across Documents and its wording was ambiguous, so the scenario was rerun with the filename-keyed comparison on unchanged guide bytes.
Layout checks are CSS-pixel measurements in three themes, not browser zoom or assistive technology acceptance.
The linked conversation guide (DOC-011) and notifications guide are still in review, and their onward targets DOC-017 and DOC-021 are unpublished; all three articles stay in review.
